label: EU(7)-PIM: clomethiazole, propiomazine
title: Clomethiazole or propiomazine in an older person
statement: Clomethiazole and propiomazine are on the list of medicines to avoid in older people. Clomethiazole carries a risk of slowed breathing. Propiomazine carries a risk of dry mouth, sedation, low blood pressure and movement side effects. If clomethiazole must be used, the list advises a reduced dose.

plain_summary: The sedatives clomethiazole and propiomazine can cause slowed breathing, drowsiness and low blood pressure in people aged 65 or over.

medicine_groups.name: Clomethiazole and propiomazine
medicine_groups.note: Clomethiazole and chlormethiazole are two spellings of the same ingredient. Match a supply recorded under either spelling. Propiomazine is a separate ingredient. Match propiomazine by its ingredient name. Match Hemineurin by brand name.

rule_for_models: Suspect a finding when the person is aged 65 or over and clomethiazole or propiomazine is supplied, even once. If age is unknown and either medicine is supplied, report only a possible finding and ask the pharmacist to confirm whether the person is at least 65.
cannot_be_seen: Why it was started, whether it was for sleep or alcohol withdrawal, how much is really taken, and whether it was supplied by a hospital or from overseas.
ask_the_gp: A review of whether the sedative is still needed and whether a safer choice or a non-medicine approach for sleep is possible.
